what: In-process Codex drafter must not treat launch_codex_exec_main process exit as Codex outcome
scenario_or_breakage: launch_codex_exec_main always returns 0 while emitting LAUNCHER_EXIT on the contract stream; calling it directly from launch_codex_drafter misclassifies Codex failures as success
suggested_fix: Refactor a shared _launch_codex_exec(...) helper that returns launcher_exit int; have launch_codex_drafter branch on that value and reserve launch_codex_exec_main for CLI emit-only wrapping

scenario_or_breakage: Bash cursor_launcher_setup_auth_argv runs preflight then preread then export; Python-only preflight+export leaves CURSOR_API_KEY unset on Darwin keychain-only hosts so Cursor lint-fix fails without ever adding --api-key
suggested_fix: After cursor_auth_preflight succeeds call agents.cursor_preread_service_token() then cursor_auth_export_env(); keep auth argv empty and assert no --api-key in tests

what: Claude drafter validation omits bash control-char and .. rejection
scenario_or_breakage: Retired launcher rejects control chars and .. in model prompt output design-tmpdir and repo-root paths; weaker Python validation accepts paths bash exited 2 on
suggested_fix: Port canonical_existing_file/dir/output_path and under_root checks (or equivalent) into launch_claude_drafter validation before DRAFTER_LAUNCHED=true

what: launch_claude_drafter must not delegate to launch_claude_subprocess_main
scenario_or_breakage: launch_claude_subprocess uses different argv order and only adds --add-dir/--permission-mode plan with --read-tools; drafter needs native --add-dir and --permission-mode plan without read-tools flags
suggested_fix: Implement launch_claude_drafter with explicit argv list matching scripts/launch-claude-drafter.sh:234 and _run_claude_with_stdin for prompt stdin

what: agent-lint S030 pins for deleted drafter/bash libs not in plan file list
scenario_or_breakage: Pins still name scripts/launch-*-drafter.sh and lib-external-launcher-common.sh after deletion; lint/agent-lint may report stale or missing allowlist targets
suggested_fix: Repoint S030 entries to python/cli.py agent launch-{codex,claude}-drafter and python/agents.py helpers in the same PR or a tracked follow-up
